title: Podcast: What to Watch When Facebook Reports Earnings
text:
Here we go again.
Facebook ( FB ) is set to report earnings after the bell Tuesday, Oct. 30. The social media giant is one of the final FANG companies to report--the last one, of course, is Apple ( AAPL ) , which is set to release Thursday, Nov. 1.
TheStreet's Annie Gaus--who covers tech--recently went through Facebook's Earnings Report on Tuesday: Here Are 3 Top Things to Watch For . Gaus writes that Facebook is down more than 30% since its July earnings report revealing slower-than-expected user growth and missed revenue targets.
So what should investors look out for? According to Gaus:
Facebook's continued security problems News feed fatigue High hopes for Instagram Other companies for investors to keep an eye on include Electronic Arts ( EA ) , Amgen ( AMGN ) , Under Armour ( UAA ) , Yum! Brands ( YUM ) , and Aetna ( AET ) . TheStreet's Martin Baccardax and Katherine Ross tackled these stocks and more in this week's Trading Strategies Podcast below:
